content: dpkt is far faster than Scapy for bulk parsing (Scapy ~130x slower in benchmarks) because Scapy builds a full mutable Python object graph per packet while dpkt does lightweight byte-offset parsing. Standard pattern for a sustained high-volume WAN capture loop: raw AF_PACKET SOCK_RAW socket (Linux) read in a tight loop, dpkt parsing each frame, in-process aggregation into a dict keyed by 5-tuple before periodic flush.
